$comment: Single source of truth for the integration tests in test/integration/. The bump script (script/test/refresh-integration-snapshot.sh) regenerates everything below. Adding or removing a test account is a JSON edit only — see docs/howto/refresh-integration-test-blocks.md.
$tolerance_comment: Max relative drift allowed between forge-computed NAV and Debank's USD total at bump time. 0.01 = 1%.
$supportedDeBankProtocols_comment: Debank protocol id allowlist per chain. The bump script filters /v1/user/all_complex_protocol_list by (chain matches debankChainId) AND (id with chain prefix stripped ∈ list). Stored as the short id (no chain prefix) — Debank uses bare ids on mainnet and `<chain>_<id>` elsewhere; the script normalises both. Add a new entry whenever a balance adapter is added for a protocol Debank covers; if Debank doesn't cover the protocol, add nothing and accept that NAV will exceed filtered-Debank by that position's value.

1.name: mainnet
1.$untracked_by_design: Protocols and wallet/reward tokens deliberately excluded from this chain's allowlist (filtered-Debank ignores them; NAV doesn't track them). Re-evaluate when an adapter/feed becomes available. PROTOCOLS — full exclusion from the supportedDeBankProtocols allowlist: balancer2 (no Bal V2 adapter; LP positions remain dust on covered accounts); sablier (no adapter; lockups today only hold unpriceable tokens like COW); acrocc_v2 (Across V2 LP — not a karpatkey protocol of interest); multichain (defunct/exploited bridge); compound (Compound V2 — only V3 covered); layer3, espresso, ekubo (small ACCOUNT_12 reward bags in non-Karpatkey protocols). PARTIAL PROTOCOL COVERAGE — protocol IS in the allowlist but only some pools/markets are wired: convex (RLUSD/crvUSD/weETH/CRV pools are wired; the cvxFXS pool ACCOUNT_12 holds is not); stakewise (V3 OsToken + Genesis Vault + MetaVault are wired; legacy V2 Rewards and Staked contracts surfaced by Debank — obsolete, no new deposits — are not); uniswap3 (most observed pools are wired or disabled, but the WETH/COW pool is intentionally disabled because COW is unpriceable); spark (lending via the Aave-fork adapter is wired; the Spark Savings USDC vault is not, so a savings balance shows as drift — e.g. ACCOUNT_11); aave3 (Aave V3 lending is wired via the DataProvider query, but Aave stata-token wrap holdings — e.g. the Lido-instance aEthLidoGHO wrap ACCOUNT_11 holds, ~$233 — are invisible to getUserReserveData and have no balance adapter, so they show as drift); aave2 (Aave V2 lending — protocol deprecated and removed from NAV; aave2 stays in the allowlist only because DeBank files stkAAVE / Safety Module under it, so a residual Aave V2 lending/collateral balance shows as drift — e.g. ACCOUNT_11); kelpdao (rsETH held in wallet or as Aave collateral is priced, and the KelpWithdrawalQueue adapter is wired for withdrawal-queue / locked positions — but as of the 2026-08-12 re-take NO fixture holds one: ACCOUNT_2's ~$282K lock, which used to be the example here, exited between blocks 25426915 and 25735412, so that adapter now has zero integration coverage. See ACCOUNT_2's note). WALLET / REWARD TOKENS without a Chainlink mainnet price feed: COW, HEX, POL (Polygon-only feed), CASHW (spam), AEVO, GEAR (Gearbox token; appears as a Merkl reward), MORPHO (Base-only feed; appears as Merkl reward and as a Balancer V3 LP component), sETH2 (StakeWise V2 legacy LST; appears in Uni V3 ETH/sETH2 LPs), EKUBO. COW-containing UniV3/PancakeSwap pools are disabled in script/config/contracts-deployment-config/balance-adapters/<chainId>.json since their COW leg can't be valued — mainnet UniswapV3_WETH_COW_3000, Base PancakeSwapV3_WETH_COW, BSC PancakeSwapV2_ETH_COW, all enabled=false and each carrying its own $comment. NOTE the path: script/config/chains/<chainId>.json holds chain metadata and role addresses ONLY and has no balanceAdapters key — adapter config moved to contracts-deployment-config/ in the #70 config split, so the old 'chains/1.json.balanceAdapters' pointer led to an object that does not exist. COW SPECIFICALLY IS PERMANENT, unlike the rest of this list: no COW price feed exists on any chain and none is planned, so the 'Re-evaluate when an adapter/feed becomes available' instruction above does NOT apply to it and it needs no periodic re-checking. Mainnet COW exposure is material — roughly $1.6M across the Sablier lockups, two wallet balances and the UniV3 pool's COW leg — so the omission is large, but it is declared: because no COW-bearing adapter is enabled, NAV reports no COW position at all and DeBank's COW value lands in this report's 'Untracked by design' section rather than as unexplained drift. PROVENANCE: unless a figure carries its own block or date, figures in this note were written against chain-1 fork block 25426915 and have NOT been re-measured since; treat them as of that block, not as current. (Individual figures may predate the note — see ACCOUNT_9's withdrawn ~$23.6M for a case where one did.) SYMBIOTIC (added 2026-08-15 with SymbioticVaultsMeta): NOT added to the allowlist above because this repo cannot verify DeBank's protocol id for it from here, and a wrong id silently filters nothing. Declared here instead, per the allowlist comment's own instruction. Consequence, stated plainly: if DeBank DOES cover Symbiotic, a fixture holding KPK USDC LiquidLane would show that position as unexplained NAV-side drift rather than as a matched protocol. No current fixture holds it (checked on-chain 2026-08-15 across all 14 accounts), so the effect is latent. Re-evaluate — and move it to supportedDeBankProtocols once the id is confirmed — before any account holding a Symbiotic vault is added as a fixture. Same applies to wARS: the token has no DeBank-side concern, but the KPK wARS Yield vault is a Morpho vault and so is already covered by the existing `morphoblue` entry.

8453.name: base
8453.$untracked_by_design: WALLET / REWARD TOKENS with no price feed: COW. PERMANENT — no COW price feed exists on any chain and none is planned, so this needs no periodic re-evaluation. The Base PancakeSwap V3 WETH/COW pool (PancakeSwapV3_WETH_COW in script/config/contracts-deployment-config/balance-adapters/8453.json) is enabled=false for the same reason: if enabled, NAVCalculator's per-asset registry filter would drop the COW leg and value the LP on its WETH side only, understating it by roughly half — worse than not reporting it. Because no COW-bearing adapter is enabled, NAV reports no COW position on Base and DeBank's COW value lands in this report's 'Untracked by design' section rather than as unexplained drift. Declared here so the classification does not depend on that adapter's enabled flag: if someone ever enables it, this entry still explains why the value is excluded. This key is documentation only — no code reads it (the report emits it as a human pointer). Scope note: it lists ONLY what has been audited for this chain, so absence of an entry is not evidence of full coverage.

Its block and method are unrecoverable, so substituting a number would inherit authority the original never had. Freshly measured in its place: **filtered DeBank $16,628,317.91 at block 25735412** (unfiltered $17,571,466.65). ITS STATED UNISWAP V3 PURPOSE IS VOID, AND UNLIKE ACCOUNT_12's IT IS STRUCTURALLY UNRECOVERABLE — not rotted. It was added to exercise the UniswapV3 adapter dispatch via a WETH/COW 0.3% LP NFT, but COW has no price feed on any chain and none is planned (see chains.1.$untracked_by_design), so BOTH routes to that pool are permanently closed: the per-instance `UniswapV3_WETH_COW_3000` entry is `enabled: false` in contracts-deployment-config/balance-adapters/1.json, and the pool is deliberately absent from UniswapV3PoolsMeta's governed instance list in nav-config/meta-balance-adapters/1.json (enabling either would be WORSE than the gap — the per-asset registry filter drops the COW leg and values the LP on its WETH side only). Measured 2026-07-30 at mainnet block 25646689: all five NonfungiblePositionManager NFTs this account holds (#1129129, #1200794, #1206590, #1213124, #1342394) are in the WETH/COW 0.3% pool, four of them with liquidity == 0 — so the account emits ZERO Uniswap V3 legs, confirmed by nav-positions-1.json recording none for it. Uniswap V3 coverage for the suite lives on ACCOUNT_11_MAINNET_COMPOUND_UNISWAP instead; do not re-derive it from this comment. Other Mainnet positions (Morpho ~$5.75M, Lido stETH ~$2.13M, USDC wallet ~$9.66M) are already covered by existing harness adapters. The small ~$560 StakeWise osETH position is covered as a Custom-priced ERC20 (osToken_CustomPriceFeed / priceFeeds.osETH) reported by ERC20DefaultBalanceAdapter. Known structural drift vs Debank-filtered: COW token ($4M wallet + ~$278K Uni V3 leg) is unpriced on Mainnet — register a custom COW feed in a follow-up to reduce drift. Sablier ($1.5M COW deposit) is still unaccounted by NAV (no Sablier adapter); excluded from supportedDeBankProtocols allowlist for chain 1 so filtered Debank stays consistent. RESIDUAL, MEASURED 2026-08-12 AT BLOCK 25735412: the tolerance gap is -$275,774.68 (nav 16,352,543.23 vs filtered-DeBank 16,628,317.91, 1.66%), while the named cause — the allowlisted `uniswap3` WETH/COW leg — is $308,758.23. **The cause OVER-EXPLAINS the gap: $32,983.55 of NAV-side value is counted that filtered DeBank does not, and it is ATTRIBUTED BELOW.** An earlier version of this note said the residual could not be itemised to a protocol from these fixtures, and told the reader not to try. THAT WAS WRONG, and it hid a real signal — do not restore it. It itemises once you pair by INSTRUMENT instead of by brand: NAV carries sGho under its Wallet brand (3,975,942.478754 sGho at $1.008728 = $4,010,643.47) while DeBank files the same holding under `aave3` as a `Yield` item (4,016,483.2245 GHO at $0.987 = $3,964,268.94). That one pairing is +$46,374.53 of the residual, and it is a GHO PRICE divergence rather than a missing position: NAV's sGho valuation implies GHO at about $0.9985 against DeBank's market mark of $0.987 across 4.0165M GHO, which is the expected fundamental-vs-market difference and not a defect. Every other paired instrument nets -$13,390.98, which is what leaves +$32,983.55. The brand-level comparison that motivated the old claim (NAV aave-v3 $2,551,192 vs DeBank aave3 $6,518,835) is a pairing artifact that nets to zero once sGho is paired with sGho, so it explains none of the residual. Deriving the residual as (gap - named cause) is still only an identity; the instrument pairing above is the attribution. So 1.66% IS accounted for — dominated by the uniswap3 WETH/COW leg and the sGho/GHO price divergence — with about $13.4K spread across small two-sided remainders that are not individually itemised here. ITEMISATION MEASURED 2026-08-12 AT BLOCK 25735412.
